name: Vestel
legalEntityNote: Vestel is a consumer brand and group-facing name, not one universal legal company. Vestel Elektronik Sanayi ve Ticaret A.Ş. is the listed company controlled by Zorlu Holding AŞ; Vestel Beyaz Eşya Sanayi ve Ticaret A.Ş. manufactures major appliances; Vestel Ticaret A.Ş. handles sales and marketing and operates the Turkish online store. Regional subsidiaries, ODM customers, licensees, importers and service providers can hold other responsibilities.
headline: Vestel appliances across Zorlu control, listed operations, manufacturing and retail entities
description: A source-backed profile of Vestel, separating the consumer brand, Zorlu Holding, Vestel Elektronik, Vestel Beyaz Eşya, Vestel Ticaret, the appliance and cleaning portfolio, ODM manufacturing and buyer checks.
metaDescription: Vestel brand profile: Zorlu control, Vestel Elektronik, appliance manufacturing, vacuums, channels and buyer checks.
disclaimer: World Clean Biz is independent and is not affiliated with Vestel or Zorlu Holding. Group ownership, factory and ODM disclosures do not establish the brand owner, manufacturer, plant, origin, importer, seller or warrantor for every Vestel or customer-brand SKU.

ownership.summary: Vestel Elektronik Sanayi ve Ticaret A.Ş. is the listed core company behind the Vestel group and brand architecture. Zorlu Holding AŞ holds 52.77% of Vestel Elektronik's capital according to the current official ownership structure, while the remainder is free float.

leadership.name: Gökhan Sığın
leadership.role: Chief Executive Officer, Vestel Group of Companies
leadership.context: Vestel's current management page says Sığın assumed the group CEO role on 19 January 2026; this is group leadership rather than a separate consumer-brand company.

productPortfolio.name: Major domestic appliances
productPortfolio.positioning: Vestel's appliance business covers refrigerators, washing machines, tumble dryers, dishwashers, cooking appliances, air conditioners and water heaters.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Confirm whether the quoted product is Vestel-branded or ODM, then verify model, energy label, plant, origin and destination certification.

productPortfolio.name: Vacuums and home cleaning
productPortfolio.positioning: The current Turkish Vestel catalogue includes robot, cordless stick, bagged, bagless and wet-dry cordless vacuum categories.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Check the exact manufacturer, battery and filter supply, app region, spare parts, noise data and warranty route.

productPortfolio.name: Small appliances and consumer electronics
productPortfolio.positioning: Vestel also sells coffee, beverage, food-preparation, cooking, ironing, television and connected-home products under the consumer brand.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Separate compliance, after-sales and category-specific legal entities across appliances, electronics and food-contact products.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: Vestel's official factory page places electronics and home-appliance production at the Vestel City complex in Manisa and describes automated Industry 4.0 operations.
manufacturingSupplyChain.scope: Vestel group manufacturing complex; not proof that every Vestel or ODM model is produced there
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Obtain the specific product's plant, line, legal manufacturer, origin and inspection records.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: Vestel Beyaz Eşya's 2024 integrated report covers six Manisa production facilities for refrigerators, washing machines, dryers, dishwashers, air conditioning, water heaters and cooking appliances.
manufacturingSupplyChain.scope: Vestel Beyaz Eşya major-appliance facilities and 2024 reporting perimeter
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Map the quoted model to one disclosed facility using current supplier and conformity documentation.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: Vestel Beyaz Eşya reports both ODM sales and branded sales under owned local and licensed global brands.
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Do not infer the consumer-facing brand from factory ownership; contractually record brand authorization, model, tooling, specifications and destination rights.

marketsChannels.evidence: Vestel's 2024 reports identify Vestel Ticaret A.Ş., a wholly owned Vestel Elektronik subsidiary, as the sales and marketing company for domestic and international appliance activity.
marketsChannels.scope: Reported group sales and marketing structure
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Confirm whether Vestel Ticaret or a regional subsidiary is the contracting party for the destination market.

marketsChannels.evidence: The Turkish Vestel online sales contract names Vestel Ticaret Anonim Şirketi Istanbul Branch as the seller.
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Do not apply the Turkish online-store seller identity to export or other-country transactions without local terms.

marketsChannels.evidence: Vestel's official Turkish site provides authorized dealer, service, installation, spare-parts and extended-cover routes across its current product range.
marketsChannels.scope: Turkish consumer channel and support system
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: For other markets, verify the authorized importer, dealer, service network, parts commitment and warranty document separately.

competitivePosition.summary: World Clean Biz assessment: Vestel combines a large, flexible European manufacturing base with consumer-brand distribution and a substantial ODM business. That scale is attractive to buyers, but it also makes brand, customer, factory and contracting-party separation essential.
